notes.title: Who's Lila is out!
notes.content:
[h1]It is finally here![/h1]

If you are reading this - my new project [b]Who's Lila?[/b] has been released! What are you waiting for? - dive within the gritty surrealistic world of the game and don't forget to make some goofy (and terrifying) faces along the way!

Who's Lila? is coming with a sweet launch discount [b]-20%[/b] for the whole week!
[h2]Get it here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1697700/Whos_Lila]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1697700/Whos_Lila[/url][/h2]

notes.title: Your Amazing T-Gotchi Vtuber Model is out now!
notes.content:
Have you not only wanted to care about a T-Gotchi, but also [b]be one[/b]?

We got you covered!

This is a Vtuber-ready Live2d T-Gotchi Model. It is currently prepared for PrPrLive and programs that utilise Live2d's native .json models!
The DLC also contains the .moc3 file, so you may alter the model if needed.

[h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1580360/Your_amazing_TGotchi_Vtuber_model]Get it now![/url][/h3]

notes.title: Community Items are now live! (Trading Cards, Backgrounds, etc.)
notes.content:
[h1]The Community Items are here![/h1]
I am happy to announce, that [b]Your amazing T-gotchi[/b] has finally met the requirements for the Community Items! Now all the [i]Backgrounds, Emoticons and Trading card[/i]s are available for sale and trading. Don't miss them!
Now available:
[list]
[*] [b]5 Trading Cards[/b]
[*] [b]7 Emoticons[/b]
[*][b] 3 Profile Backgrounds[/b]
[/list]
